model.inputs: Match odds use results since 2003 plus temporary team news and ACL adjustments. Season odds stay results only. Bookmaker prices are shown beside the model and are not an input.

this_season.note: Ranked probability score, lower is better; baseline = league home/draw/away rates

team_news_test.note: Ranked probability score, lower is better. Negative difference = team news made forecasts better.

model_v_market.source: Closing odds: football-data.co.uk (market average, margin removed)
model_v_market.note: Ranked probability score, lower is better. Rounds before publishing are walk-forward backtest forecasts.

season_race.note: Chart through R14, completed rounds only. The Season Odds table above updates after individual matches, so its latest figures can differ until the round is finished. Pre = pre-season. History uses today's model, not forecasts published at the time.

adjustments_info.note: p_home/p_draw/p_away include the listed adjustments; results_only is the model before them. Season odds use results only.
adjustments_info.acl_note: ACL congestion is no longer a flat figure (D-035). acl_elo is the full-strength case; a club that rotated gets less and a long away trip adds more, so a match can carry 0, -5, -10 or -15. Each match's own figure and reason are in its adjustments list; use those, not this number.

player_importance.note: A player's absence is scaled by how important he is (D-037).
